content: Task: association-rule analysis - find item sets that co-occur in transactions more than chance and rules of the form 'these items present implies this item present' | requires: transaction records listing items, minimum support and confidence thresholds | produces: frequent item sets and rules with support, confidence and lift | families: DM (Apriori, FP-growth and other frequent-itemset algorithms) | metrics: support, confidence and lift, and usefulness against the business question
